Technical Support Engineer – Romania 
 Please find the updated job details below for posting:
 Position: Technical Support Engineer (Romania Branch)
 Salary range: 2000-3500€
 Location: Strada Crizantemei 43, Buftea 070000, Romaia
 Key responsibilities: 
Handle technical support inquiries via Romanian hotline
Provide after-sales support via WhatsApp and email
Collect, analyze, and report technical issues to the China team for timely resolution
Support customers with troubleshooting and product guidance
Occasionally travel within Romania or other locations for on-site support, training, or customer visits
Support other tasks assigned by the supervisor
 Requirements: 
Background in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields
Familiarity with PV and energy storage systems is a plus
Romanian, Chinese and English proficiency for daily communication
Strong communication and problem-solving skills
Ability to work with international teams independently
Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel when needed
